dev.off()
#buka data airquality
data(airquality)
head(airquality)
str(airquality)
summary(airquality)

#buat histogram dan density
Wind<-airquality$Wind
#histogram
hist(Wind,
freq=F,
col="purple",
border="black",
main="Histogram dan densitas Wind",
xlab="Wind(mph)")
lines(density(Wind),col="black",lwd=2)
#boxplot
boxplot(Wind,
main="Boxplot wind",
ylab="Wind(mph)",
col="yellow")
#stem
stem(Wind)
#scatter plot
plot(airquality$Wind, airquality$Ozone,
main = "Scatter Plot: Wind vs Ozone",
xlab = "Wind (mph)",
ylab = "Ozone (ppb)",
pch = 19, col = "steelblue")
#scatter plot matrix
pairs(airquality[ , 1:4],
      main = "Scatter Plot Matrix - airquality")

par(mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
hist(Wind, freq = FALSE, col = "lightblue",
     main = "Histogram dan Densitas Wind", xlab = "Wind (mph)")
lines(density(Wind), col = "darkblue", lwd = 2)
